children: Abu Dhabi-listed ADNOC Distribution intends to expand its operations in Egypt with a $1 billion investment, according to a news report.
The investment will allow the addition of 400 new fuel stations in Egypt, Asharq Business reported, quoting an unnamed Egyptian government official.

The expansion will be executed in two phases of 200 fuel stations each, the report said. The company currently operates 245 service stations in Egypt and holds a 50% stake in TotalEnergies Marketing Egypt.

ADNOC Distribution is exploring several expansion models, including establishing its own fuel stations for the first time in Egypt, partnering with the state-owned Egyptian General Petroleum Corporation (EGPC), or leasing some existing sites.

The company, which is majority owned by ADNOC’s XRG, n will also invest an additional $50 million in aircraft refueling business at Sphinx and Hurghada airports through an agreement with EGPC, the report said.

title: ADNOC unit explores $1bln investment in fuel station expansion in Egypt: Report
